//: Local configuration for the authoring scripts. NOT COMMITTED.
Copy this to manuscripts.json (gitignored) and fill it in, or point
AIFIRST_MANUSCRIPTS at a copy kept outside the checkout entirely.
chmod 600 manuscripts.json     it holds an API key
Only the scrape, import-showtail and enrich authoring tools read this. Nothing that ships does,
and CI has neither the file nor the key.
//manuscripts: Each root is the folder holding that book's chapter .docx files. The books are
not open source, which is why these paths are not committed. Omit a book you do
not have and the scraper skips it; a path that does not exist is an error,
because silently scraping nothing looks exactly like 'no changes'.
//anthropicApiKey: Used by `bun run enrich` to write explanations. ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the
environment takes precedence, so a machine that already exports one needs
nothing here. The script refuses to read a key from this file if git is not
